title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar, Malibu Collection Contemporary Bath Accessory Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bath with a wall mount towel bar featuring a sleek, contemporary straight-bar design and solid brass construction. This 18-inch center-to-center towel bar is part of the Malibu collection, making it easy to build a coordinated look with matching Malibu accessories.

Highlights:
- Contemporary bath accessories styling: clean, straight bar profile
- Solid brass construction
- Wall-mounted towel rack / towel holder installation saves floor space
- All mounting hardware included; no assembly required
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement finishes

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 18 in
- Overall length: 20 in
- Projection: 3.39 in
- Height: 2 in; Width: 3.39 in
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Malibu 18 inch Towel Bar
_previous.description: The Malibu towel bar will add a sleek contemporary look to your bathroom. Crafted out of solid brass, the Malibu towel bar offers the quality and design found in high-end bath accessories but at a very affordable price. The bar comes in both 18” or 24” and is available in a wide variety of colors. Match it together with the coordinating Malibu Hand Towel Holder, Malibu Toilet Tissue Holder and Malibu Robe Hook to complete your bathroom decor.

Modern bathroom with white large-format porcelain tiles, chrome fixtures. The towel bar is mounted on the wall outside a glass shower enclosure.

Negative space emphasizes the architectural lines of the fixture.
